## First, a correction

**NEBNext UltraShear (M7634) is an enzymatic fragmentation reagent, not an instrument.** A thermal cycler controls incubation. The formulation is designed to fragment DNA upstream of short-read library preparation while retaining methylation marks.

| Input | Reaction | Output | Immediate data |
|---|---|---|---|
| purified tissue genomic DNA | timed UltraShear incubation and heat inactivation | fragmented tissue DNA | fragment-size trace, concentration, yield |

The [NEB manual](https://www.neb.com/en/-/media/nebus/files/manuals/manualm7634.pdf) describes 5–250 ng purified gDNA and time-dependent fragmentation at 37°C followed by heat inactivation; the exact study conditions must be fixed during validation. The manual warns that the coupled EM-seq protocol differs from standard standalone paths.

## Why only tissue?

Tissue genomic DNA needs controlled fragmentation for Illumina library construction. Plasma cfDNA is already fragmented in vivo; deliberately re-shearing it would erase or distort the native fragmentomic signal.

## QC gate

Review the full fragment distribution—not only its mean—plus input mass, reaction time, buffer, lot, replicate, and recovery. Fragmentation must be balanced across groups. Tissue insert length is a preparation characteristic, not a nucleosome footprint.
